tools.name: capture_traffic
tools.description: Start capturing HTTP traffic through the APiX proxy.

filter.description: Optional URL pattern (regex) to filter captured requests.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to capture.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Retrieve previously captured HTTP transactions from storage.

tools.name: set_breakpoint
tools.description: Add a breakpoint rule that pauses requests matching a URL pattern.

url_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against request URLs.

method.description: HTTP method filter. Empty means all methods.

tools.name: resume_request
tools.description: Resume a paused request with one of forward, drop, or respond actions.

response_body.description: Response body string when action is 'respond'.

tools.name: replay_request
tools.description: Replay a previously captured request, optionally with modifications.

request_id.description: ID of the request to replay from history.

override_url.description: Send the replayed request to a different URL.
